# aj dashboard

Find dashboards.


## `aj dashboard list`

Search dashboards.

```text
aj dashboard list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--name` `TEXT` |  | Name contains. |
| `--owner` `TEXT` |  | Owner: email, name or @me. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj dashboard view`

Show a dashboard.

```text
aj dashboard view DASHBOARD_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DASHBOARD_ID` | required | Dashboard id. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
